Ask your team where a lead stands.
If the answer is "let me check my WhatsApp", the pipeline has a gap.

Leads rarely disappear in one moment. They fade between the first reply and the viewing nobody booked.

A simple pipeline routine for agencies in Qatar:

• Give every lead a stage
For example new, contacted, viewing, negotiation. Agents and managers should see the same picture.

• Log the activity, not just the result
Calls, WhatsApp messages and viewings belong on the lead record, not in someone's memory.

• Let the system nudge you
A notification when a new lead arrives means nobody waits for a reply.

• Route leads with rules
Assignment rules send each lead to the right agent or team the moment it lands.

OneLinker CRM brings this together: leads from the portals, Meta lead forms, Google Ads and your website in one inbox, with lead stages, activities, notifications and assignment rules.
